title: A Unified Heat-Ball Framework for Fokker--Planck Equations: Mean-Value Identities, Exact Sampling, and Error Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2606.27954v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models with nonlinear or learned forward drifts raise questions that stay hidden for Gaussian forward processes: how the divergence-free and gradient parts of the drift shape the evolving density, whether sampling can draw on local rather than global information, and how to treat low-density regions, where $u$ carries a weak signal while $\log u$ diverges and the entropy density $u\log u$ falls between the two. These questions motivate the present study of local representations for Fokker--Planck equations with general, possibly nonlinear and time-dependent drift. We derive inhomogeneous heat-ball identities for the density $u$, the log-density $\log u$, the entropy density $u\log u$, and the score $\nabla\log u$, keeping the source terms generated by the drift; their unscaled residuals recover the corresponding differential residuals at leading order in the squared heat-ball radius. translated_title: Fokker–Planck方程的统一热球框架：均值恒等式、精确采样与误差分析
translated_abstract: 具有非线性或学习得到的前向漂移的扩散生成模型提出了一些在高斯前向过程中被掩盖的问题：漂移的无散度部分与梯度部分如何塑造演化中的密度，采样能否利用局部而非全局信息，以及如何处理低密度区域——在这些区域中 $u$ 携带微弱信号，而 $\log u$ 发散，熵密度 $u\log u$ 则介于两者之间。这些问题促使本研究探讨具有一般性、可能为非线性且时变的漂移的 Fokker–Planck 方程的局部表示。我们推导了密度 $u$、对数密度 $\log u$、熵密度 $u\log u$ 以及得分函数 $\nabla\log u$ 的非齐次热球恒等式，并保留了由漂移产生的源项；其未缩放的残差在热球平方半径的最低阶意义上恢复出相应的微分残差。（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的非齐次热球框架，为具有一般非线性、时变漂移的 Fokker–Planck 方程推导出密度、对数密度、熵密度与得分函数的局部均值恒等式，从而为扩散生成模型中漂移结构的分析、局部化采样以及低密度区域的处理提供了新工具。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a unified inhomogeneous heat-ball framework that derives local mean-value identities for the density, log-density, entropy density, and score of Fokker–Planck equations with general nonlinear, time-dependent drifts, enabling analysis of drift structure, local sampling, and low-density regions in diffusion-based generative models.
